messages:
lir: Quick note from today's partner onboarding: the README curl example uses `Authorization: Token ...` instead of `Bearer ...` which causes some libs (requests, curl -H) to treat it weirdly. Also the Python sample instantiates `Redwood()` instead of `RedwoodClient()` so the snippet errors on import.
nina: Oof. That explains the support tickets. Can you paste the exact curl from the README?
lir: Sure — current README snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
sam: Two things: header prefix should be `Bearer` (not `Token`), and the Python example should show construction with `api_key=` for clarity. Also mention Windows CMD vs PowerShell env var syntax.
nina: Agree. Proposal for replacement snippets:
```bash
# POSIX
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'

# PowerShell
$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<key>"; curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
```py
# python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
res = client.generate(prompt="hello")
```

sam: Also worth adding an explicit note: older docs used RW_API_KEY; flag that so folks don't copy legacy examples.
lir: I'll open a PR to update README and add a short troubleshooting blurb. Can someone volunteer to add a docs-lint rule that checks for "Authorization: Token" and RW_API_KEY?
nina: I'll take the lint rule. We can add a simple regex check to docs-lint for known bad auth prefixes and legacy env names.
docs-bot: Link to current file: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/samples/sample-app/README.md
lir: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901 — fixes curl header, updates python and node samples, and adds PowerShell note.
lint-bot: docs-lint: snippet-check FAILED on branch refs/pull/901/head - detected deprecated token prefix at README.md:23. See CI run: https://ci.redwood.ai/234567
sam: Nice that lint caught it before merge. Nina, once your rule lands we can prevent regressions.
nina: I'll push the rule as a follow-up PR and add unit tests. Expect it today.
lir: Merged and deployed to staging site. I also added a one-liner to onboarding playbook to remind SEs to use the quickstart copy script instead of copy/paste.
sam: Great. Closing the loop on support tickets. :white_check_mark:
